title: DOES NOT FIT EVEN THE SMALLEST RECLINER!
text: DOES NOT FIT EVEN THE SMALLEST RECLINER!. This will not fit even the smallest recliner! Save your money! What a waste of money! A joke! It might fit a kitchen chair but no way will it fit a recliner!!!

product_metadata.title: Linen Store Quilted Microfiber Pet Furniture Protector Cover with Tucks and Straps, Beige, Sofa
features: PROTECT: protects furniture from stains, pet hair/fur. Great for homes with kids and pets
PREVENT SLIDING: features 7" tucks on 3 sides under the cover (which tuck into cushion grooves) and Elastic Strap to help furniture protector stay in place. NOT RECOMMENDED FOR LEATHER COUCH
description: Protects furniture from pets, kids, stains and more with this great quality furniture protectors. It is made of quilted microfiber material to keep your furniture looking new. Soil and stain resistant. It helps cover the back of the sofa as well. Easy to set up with 7" tuck drops located under the covers tuck in between couch cushion grooves to hold them in place. Very soft micro-fiber fabric, which very comfortable to sit on. Machine washable.
